documents.text: Head-on collision at low speed in a residential area on 2026-01-30; airbags did not deploy, front bumper crumpled.
Front bumper and radiator support replacement: $8,000.

ground_truth.notes: Reported damage ($8,000) is below the major-damage benchmark floor ($10,000) despite the incident being described as major — damage category classification looks inconsistent with the report.
